text: Oil on the gum. The chamber will not lengthen because a man wants a walk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Grendon, in July. The constable, and his big words. Then the weavers and the shearmen, arguing the old guild plays, as they argued them when I was a boy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Golding. Pyramus and Thisbe, talking through a crack in a wall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And then one figure that is all three. A weaver who will play the lover and the lady and the lion, with an ass's head on him, very solemn about it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A man with a head like— no. A man who'd play the wall if you let him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Clove's working. Mark it, and sleep.
